title: Add a command threshold, a turn bonus and a pay floor to the experimental yaw gate
summary: locomotion.task_v4_yaw_gate gains yaw_gate_min_command_rad_s, which limits the gate to commands that turn at least that fast, yaw_gate_bonus, which pays a turn that matches its command up to 1 + bonus times v4's schedule pay, and yaw_gate_floor, which keeps that share of the schedule pay on a covered command whatever the turn. On the surrogate, seed 20260917, 5000 updates, with 30 percent turn draws, a 120-control gate window and a 0.18 rad/s threshold: bonus 0.5 passed 8 of 13 learning probes and turned left at 0.206 rad/s but right at -0.090; bonus 0.25 with floor 0.5 passed 8 of 13, turned at 0.189 and -0.166 rad/s and held heading within 0.039 rad/s on every translation. Turn-heavy sampling without the gate passed 10 of 13 and turned at 0.161 and -0.197 rad/s; the v4 control passed 5 of 13. The defaults keep earlier behaviour; native runs remain the acceptance evidence.
next: Run a second surrogate seed of turn-heavy sampling with and without the bonus-and-floor gate, then propose one configuration for a native 5000-update run.
reason: Opt-in options of an experimental task with surrogate design evidence change no native result, gate or default reward.
